pages.text:
## Pinterest REST API 5.32.0

The Pinterest API significantly increases the scope of what is possible for you to create as a site or application developer. Access to the Pinterest API can be used for:

* Conversion tracking: Send conversion events.
* Content management: View, edit, delete Pins and boards.
* Ad management: View, edit, delete campaigns, ad groups, and ads.
* Media planning: Get campaign delivery estimates for reach, frequency, and other metrics.
* Targeting: View, edit, delete customer lists, audiences, trending keywords, and other targeting options.
* Shopping management: View, edit, delete catalog feeds and product groups.
* Analytics and reporting: Request analytics for your Pins, ads, ad groups, campaigns, or accounts.

In this reference, you will find information on all endpoints available in the Pinterest API. For implementation guides on supported use cases, visit our Docs page.

## Just getting started?

To get started with the Pinterest API and learn about what you need to do to authenticate, read this section of the API documentation. Alternatively, check out our development quickstart guide or Python SDK.

Share feedback

Share feedback

# Make an API call
Confirm whether you have access to the API by making a successful request.
First, ensure you've:
1. Completed the steps to [connect your app](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/getting-started/connect-app/) and have been approved for access.
2. Recently created an [access token](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/getting-started/set-up-authentication-and-authorization/#generate-an-access-token). If it's expired, you'll need to [refresh it](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/getting-started/set-up-authentication-and-authorization/#refreshing-and-storing-tokens).
Use the following command to make a request to the [`pins/list`](https://developers.pinterest.com/docs/api/v5/pins-list). This will return a list of pins in your account.
```bash
curl --location --request GET 'https://api.pinterest.com/v5/pins' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR\_TOKEN' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
It should return a JSON response with a list of pins. If you have no pins, it will return an empty array, like so:
```json
{ "items": [], "bookmark": null }
```
\*\*Congratulations!\*\* You've made your first successful API call!
Keep exploring our docs and see what else is possible with the Pinterest API.

Pinterest works for all kinds of businesses, from small shops to global brands. It’s free to sign up for a business account and easy to start making Pins.

Make Pins to show the world what you’re about. Use images or videos to display your ideas, products and more.

We’ll show your Pins to the people we think are most likely to love them. People can comment, react or even add photos of Pins they’ve tried.

Turn your Pins into ads so they can be seen by more people. Combining organic and paid content is the best way to succeed on Pinterest.2

Merchant tools

Turn Pins into purchases

Use our shopping solutions to upload your catalog and promote your products.

Promote your products to reach more people and work toward performance goals.

Work with one of our third-party partners to set up your feed, create shoppable experiences and more.

Join the Verified Merchant Program to show that your store was vetted by the Pinterest team.

Build engagement from your website

Claiming your site ensures that your brand name appears on every Pin people create from your site.

The follow widget helps your site visitors follow you on Pinterest—without ever leaving your site. We also offer widgets that let people save Pins or boards directly from your site.

Rich Pins automatically sync information from your site, to your Pins. They help you add more info directly to the Pin so people learn more about your products or ideas.

Analytics and measurement

Put our insights to work

Audience insights show who you’re reaching and what they care about.

Get an instant read on individual Pin performance, or deep dive into rich analytics that show your engagement metrics.

Once you know which Pins are doing well, promote them and reach more people.

Support to help you study up

Take free courses and attend webinars from Pinterest marketing experts. On our free learning platform you’ll get tactical, in-depth training on campaign setup, creative best practices, optimization strategies and more.

Join a growing community of businesses and creators. Look for ideas, swap best practices and ask for advice.

Get started

Frequently asked questions

Business accounts include additional features beyond standard Pinterest accounts. This includes special business tools like analytics and audience insights, plus access to Pinterest ads.

It’s free to sign up for a Pinterest business account. And if you decide to run ads, you can always set your own budget.

You can create a new business account or convert your existing personal account into a business account. From there, you’ll be able to add Pins, create ad campaigns, reach new customers and more.

People use Pinterest to find fresh, original ideas. Wow them with a visually captivating story, or use Pinterest trends to help you create content based on what people want to try next. Since content stays discoverable on Pinterest well past your publication date, people can keep discovering your ideas long after you publish a Pin.

Check out our creative best practices for tips on how to make eye-catching Pins that will help you reach your goals.

We offer many tools to help you get better business results. Ads can help boost results across the funnel. You can also use our shopping tools to help sell more products or run performance marketing campaigns. Then, get insight into performance with our sophisticated analytics and measurement solutions.

You can run campaigns against any goal, from awareness to conversions. Learn more about ad tools and formats on our dedicated page.

Get more out of your advertising with Pinterest Academy, our free learning platform that covers everything from basic setup to optimization tactics.

Go to My apps and click through to accept our Developer Terms of Service

Once you've completed these requirements we'll ask for more details to register your app.

Register your app details to get your app ID and secret key

While logged into the Pinterest account you want to use to administer your app complete the following steps:

Select Connect app and complete our request form with your app information. Your app name can be in any language, but it must include at least 3 Latin letters or numbers (A-Z, a-z, 0-9) and can't contain the word "Pinterest".

Submit your request for trial access.

Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest. You will receive an email notification after your app has been reviewed, letting you know whether it was approved or denied access.

If your app is approved for Trial access, you can log into your account and manage your app details on your My apps page. In your My apps view, you'll be able to find details such as your unique app ID and app secret.

We accept multiple redirect URIs when configuring your app. The value given for redirect\_uri during OAuth authorization will be matched against the redirect URIs listed in your app profile. They must be an exact match to avoid any exceptions. The specified redirect URI must not cause the responding server to send a secondary redirect to yet another URI.

Go to My apps and select Manage for the app you want to configure.

On the Configure tab scroll to the Redirect URIs section and enter your desired URI

Select Add to save your changes

Build a working authentication flow based on OAuth 2

Make an authorization request to our OAuth page in your browser

Handle the OAuth redirect to the appropriate location (e.g. localhost for testing)

Exchange the authorization code for an access token

Store the access token and refresh it as needed

Helpful resources

We offer a range of Developer tools to help you get started with the Pinterest API quickly.

API Quickstart: Quickly get code samples and scripts with our API quickstart repo.There you can:

Put your app ID and app secret key in an environment script file

Run the sample environment set-up script and verify the results

Python SDK: Our SDK currently offers a Python library that supports campaign management and simplifies authentication and error handling. Check it out here

Product limited tokens: Once your app is approved for Trial access you can generate a token to test the API without setting up the Oauth flow.Test tokens expire after 24 hours and allow you to explore certain endpoints faster.

# Using beta and restricted features

The Pinterest API includes features that are in beta release as well as features that have restricted use. We identify these features with labels in the developer docs.

Beta features are typically still in development. We encourage you to test them and provide feedback using this form, so that we can gauge their value and make improvements. Beta time windows vary from a few weeks to open-ended durations.

Pinterest releases two types of beta features:

* Open beta features are available to all developers with access to the Pinterest API.
* Closed beta features are available to specific invited developers and organizations. In some cases, we also grant access by request.

Certain released features are only available to specific organizations. They are labeled Restricted in the documentation.

Restricted features are also referred to as advanced elsewhere on Pinterest sites.

If you try to call a restricted or closed beta endpoint without having been granted access by a Pinterest representative, you are likely to receive an error response indicating that you do not have access.

## Request access to closed beta or restricted features

Reach out to your Pinterest representative or contact Support. Make sure to have your app ID available.

To submit a Support request for access to an API feature:

* Go to

  How can we help?

  in Help Center.
* Type API in the search box. The search is not case sensitive.
* Select Request Access to Beta or Restricted Features from the results.
* Click Still need more help?
* Enter and submit the requested information.
